right: ARMOUR, SUIT, TRACKSUIT, NINJA, HAWAIIAN). Repaint this SAME sheet with exactly ONE change.

THE CHANGE: every torso still has an upper-arm SLEEVE or SHOULDER CAP painted on its side - armour: the big sand-coloured shoulder pauldron
with the emblem; suit: the big rounded navy jacket sleeve top (with the brown harness strap over it); tracksuit: the rounded black sleeve top
with the white and orange stripes; ninja: the big rounded black shoulder; hawaiian: the red flower-print short sleeve with its hem.
REMOVE ALL OF THESE COMPLETELY. The game draws the arms as separate parts on top, so the torso must show NO arm, NO sleeve, NO shoulder pad,
NO pauldron and NO rounded deltoid bulge at all.
In their place paint the garment's own flat SIDE PANEL: the side of the chest and ribs seen exactly from the side, running straight from the
top of the torso down to the waist, in the same fabric / armour as the rest of that torso, with at most a thin vertical side seam.
Seen from the side the top of every torso is then: the collar, and behind it a smooth, gently sloping shoulder line down to the upper back
(the trapezius) - no bump, no ball, no cap.

KEEP EVERYTHING ELSE IDENTICAL: the same five outfits, colours, materials and gear, the same collars, the same strict right-facing side
profile (chest on the right, spine on the left), the same outline weight and cel shading, and the same size and position of each torso.
Gear that crossed the sleeve continues across the side panel instead: the suit's harness strap and holster, the ninja's chest-plate straps.
The hawaiian keeps its red flower-print shirt fabric on the side panel (no sleeve) under the black tactical vest.
Every torso stays a SOLID body: NO holes, NO arm openings, NO dark interiors.
Fully transparent background, NO glow or coloured halo behind the torsos, NO text, NO labels. Torsos never touch each other.
Image size 1536x1024 (landscape).
